document_title: Alaska's One Row on the Federal AI List
post_copy:
Enstar is warning about rolling blackouts and fielding new data center interest in the same week.
Alaska's one federal AI award points at the grid, not at the new load.

278 projects on the Department of Energy's Genesis Mission list, posted July 22.

Exactly one row is Alaska's, a UAF project called AURORA-AI, Alaska Utility Resilience and Optimization using Real-time AI.

Six days later Enstar president John Sims said a winter like last year's would likely bring rolling blackouts.

The Anchorage Daily News reported Enstar is weighing whether it is prudent to add new customers at all, citing rising interest in data center development.

No dollar figure has been published for Alaska's row. No description either.

So what would Alaska's one row have to be worth, in dollars, before it counts as a federal answer to this winter?

#AlaskaEnergy #GenesisMission #Railbelt
